{{Quote|She took the skimmer?|[[Jannah]]|<ref name="Episode 9">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>}}
'''Sea skiff number one''' was one of two [[sea skiff]] watercraft constructed and used by the [[Company 77]] tribe on [[Kef Bir]]. It was used by [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] to travel to the [[Death Star ruins|ruins]] of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], to search for the [[Emperor's wayfinder]].<ref name="TROSVD" />
